title: S8 Asset and Lifecycle Carrier Mapping Fields

entries.name: Mapping ID
entries.description: Stable governed identifier for the mapping between a source information carrier and one or more lifecycle schema fields.

entries.name: Source Container / Element Type
entries.description: Model element type, asset record, external data source or other originating information container.

entries.name: Target Schema ID
entries.description: Governed asset or lifecycle schema receiving the mapped information.

entries.name: Target Field ID(s)
entries.description: One or more governed lifecycle field identifiers populated or constrained by the mapping.

entries.name: Carrier Mechanism
entries.description: Mechanism carrying the information, such as model parameter, external database field, COBie-style worksheet column or other governed carrier.

entries.name: Source Field / Parameter Reference
entries.description: Stable reference to the originating field, shared parameter, property or other governed source identifier where applicable.

entries.name: Transformation / Mapping Rule
entries.description: Declared transformation, lookup, normalization or mapping logic where a direct identity mapping is not sufficient.

entries.name: Export / Import Path Reference
entries.description: High-level reference to the governed exchange or implementation path; tool-specific procedural detail remains in L6 instructions or project annexes.

entries.name: Sequence / Dependency
entries.description: Required sequencing or dependency, such as population before handover package generation or prerequisite validation.

entries.name: Validation Reference
entries.description: Applicable ATS, validation rule, schema checker, rulepack or other governed evidence route for the mapping.

entries.name: Status
entries.description: Governed lifecycle state such as proposed, approved, deprecated or superseded.

entries.name: Effective From
entries.description: Date, version or governed condition from which the mapping applies.

governance_notes: Mappings connect S8 semantics to concrete carriers without making a software product or export mechanism the source of semantic authority.
Project-specific mappings may specialize this structure only where the governing information requirement, schema version and carrier are declared.
Tool UI steps and detailed export/import procedures belong in L6 instructions or BEP annexes, not in this registry.

provenance.source_title: Governance Metadata and Asset Schema Registry
provenance.migration_note: Migrates the mapping/carrier layer of GAP-S8-03 while keeping tool procedures and project/client mappings outside enterprise doctrine.
